findings.text: the three reading keys this module requires — five_hour_used_percent, seven_day_used_percent and seven_day_reset_at, read at :246 — are named nowhere else in the tree, a grep over reckon/, tests/ and docs/ returning only these definitions and the test's own fixture, while the readings the crew already produces publish utilisation as a fraction (reckon/budget.py:1750 _clock) or utilisation_pct as a percentage (reckon/budget.py:124 BudgetState), so any real payload a wiring node hands over yields fill None, bar None and pace None and the wallet's figures never resolve.

the bar label reads 0.055 at fill 0.14 where the code gives 0.053312 — bar._bar_threshold(0.14) = 0.14 times 0.14 times (3 - 2 times 0.14), the same figure the test asserts at tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py:149 — and the plan's alt text at docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html:613 repeats 0.055, so the figure a reader checks the landing against carries a number the code does not produce.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits — bb971efb adding the wallet resolution and its 206-line test file, 7a9429f7 adding the plan record, the wallet figure and the cumulative evidence anchor — and the base-to-head diff is the code, its test, and three documentation artifacts, nothing else.
item_verdicts.done_when: the dispatch's first clause — that reckon/schema/flight.yaml declares a budget_group for each of the four sol-family lanes — cannot hold in this repository, because the schema declares the slot and names no backend (its own description at reckon/schema/flight.yaml:470 says a pool is declared, never inferred, so the values live in the host layer), and the node reported exactly that as a follow-on rather than editing outside its fence; the rest of the done-when holds, with the four sol lanes resolving to one wallet by count and name at tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py:110-117 and the declared negative control reddening its named case.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a wallet's pace, bar and reserve are computed once per wallet rather than once per lane; reckon/crew/budget_group.py:211 group_figures resolves the declared group's freshest member and returns the wallet's fill, allowance, bar and reserve from that one reading, raising ValueError at :238 for a lane identifier, so the once-per-wallet half is delivered while the declarations it reads were already carried by the host layer's flight.yaml and not created here.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; its gate-declaration.log records 22 passed at exit 0 but carries no revision or command header, and my re-run of the new file alone from the reviewed worktree at 7a9429f7 reproduced 8 passed in 0.38s with the module resolving to that worktree; its negative control's first line repeats the dispatch's declared mutation verbatim and the named test fails on assert 3 == 4.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's five declared paths against the dispatch's eight; git diff --stat b453d7632ec4d56392caba3b1efde4aa0475b23b 7a9429f72f3bb4a3f99ac4c99c2d753647186d40 touches exactly those five files, and the three schema/flight paths are untouched because the checked-in schema JSON would need regeneration only for a schema change and none was made.

justifications.durability: eight focused tests cover the refusal case, the unobserved-wallet case and the stale-member case, the manifest records the cohort file set at 54 passed both at base and at this head, and the fixture asserts the workstation's own configuration home is byte-identical after the run; the gap is that no producer's payload reaches the fill path.
justifications.evidence: my re-run at 7a9429f7 reproduces the 8-pass gate with the serving module printed, and the declared mutation is recorded verbatim, but the gate log carries no revision header and the test's fixture is written in the module's own invented spelling, so the evidence shows the module agrees with itself rather than with any reading a producer emits.
justifications.fit: the module sits in reckon/crew beside budget.py's existing per-group report and names things cleanly with no forbidden names, but it introduces three reading keys in a spelling the tree does not use and a second per-wallet entry point where reckon/budget.py:1969 already reports per-group allowance and bar from the established window readings, and nothing calls the new entry point yet.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/budget_group.py:211-238 computes the wallet's fill, allowance, bar and reserve from one freshest-member reading and refuses a lane identifier, which is the node goal; the reservation is that the declarations half was pre-existing host-layer data, as the schema itself states.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches five of the eight declared write paths, all three untouched paths deliberately so and reported as such in the manifest's evidence_inputs.
